research_question: Can the V28 complementary market-state idea retain its economics when the bull continuation detector is reduced to five causal, visually interpretable condition groups?
evidence_warning: Threshold values are inherited from the previously observed V65 neighborhood. The identities and outcomes of the expanded five-group bull population have not been inspected at this freeze, but this remains iterative research rather than pristine hypothesis formation.

economic_sequence.bear: causally known broad weakness -> stock-specific forced selling or exhausted downside supply -> completed strong demand bar -> next legal open -> T10 or H20
economic_sequence.bull: broad participation -> PIT industry breadth ignition -> underextended stock -> first controlled 20-session pressure break -> next legal open -> T15 or H15

bear_source.identity: the two exact frozen V27 Bear lanes, unchanged
bear_source.immutable_source: V28 Stage-A source union, SHA256 f3cb511657745245a5c62c8cc5c264f56c2faa97096b39cd470d79271d929841; use only source == V27_BEAR
bear_source.reason: the upstream V27 Parquet was mechanically rewritten after V28 freeze; row-level contents matched exactly, but V29 fails closed on byte drift and therefore consumes the already hash-frozen V28 copy

simple_bull_five_groups.2_industry_ignition: industry20 > 3%, industry_breadth20 > 60%, and its five-session change >= 25 percentage points
simple_bull_five_groups.3_underextended_stock: ret60 between 0% and 15% and zero prior-20 upper-limit closes
simple_bull_five_groups.4_controlled_first_pressure_break: close above the known prior-20 coordinate high, signal return between 2% and 6%, and close location >= 70%
simple_bull_five_groups.5_turnover_confirmation: signal turnover / prior-20 mean turnover between 1.5 and 4.0
simple_bull_five_groups.cooldown: at least 21 market cal_idx between raw simple-bull events for the same symbol

explicitly_removed_v65_gates: early-lane prior-250 peak age >= 120 calendar days

causal_clock.entry: first legal daily open strictly after signal and within three market sessions
causal_clock.target: +15% from executable entry coordinate; first legal realization after entry
causal_clock.time_stop: H15 completed-session decision then first legal sellable open

analysis_plan.freeze_first: build and hash all simple-bull candidate identities through 2026-09-04 without calculating their returns
analysis_plan.then: attach frozen T15/H15 outcomes and combine with unchanged V27 Bear rows under one causal portfolio replay
analysis_plan.no_search: no alternative threshold, condition, target, horizon, ranking, or portfolio grid in V29
analysis_plan.failure_diagnostic: if V29 fails, attribute degradation to the removed semantic components by population overlap and chronology only; do not rescue V29

governance.claim_if_passed: iterative simple causal candidate; future paper validation required
